prompt: Create a highly detailed anime-style fantasy carnival portrait of Liberté from Rage of Bahamut, shown from thighs up in a dynamic close perspective, leaning toward the viewer with a mischievous open-mouth smile and tiny fangs. The setting is a dark magical circus tent at night with rich burgundy, violet, and magenta lighting, red ribbons and streamers, triangular bunting, glowing string lights, a tilted sign partly reading “WELCOME TO THE CIRCUS,” a ladder in the background, scattered circus props, playing-card motifs including a visible heart card in the lower right, and sparkling dust in the air. Use dramatic rim light, glossy highlights, shallow depth of field, intricate fabric rendering, high contrast, cinematic composition, and polished Japanese gacha-card illustration quality. Keep the image vertical square-crop friendly, energetic, richly detailed, and centered on the character’s face and clawed paws; avoid extra characters, modern objects, watermarks, or readable text beyond the partial circus sign.
